items.title: Singapore to Ensure AI Helps Workers Worried About Jobs, PM Says
items.content: Singapore is benefitting from the rapid growth of artificial intelligence and the government is making use of the technology to ensure higher productivity and better jobs for workers who are worried about their livelihoods, Prime Minister Lawrence Wong said.
items.contentSnippet: Singapore is benefitting from the rapid growth of artificial intelligence and the government is making use of the technology to ensure higher productivity and better jobs for workers who are worried about their livelihoods, Prime Minister Lawrence Wong said.
items.creator: Shamim Adam and Philip J. Heijmans

summaries.zh: 新加坡正受益于人工智能的快速发展。总理王毅表示，政府将利用该技术提升生产力，确保就业岗位的质量，以帮助那些对工作感到担忧的工人。
summaries.en: Singapore is leveraging AI's rapid growth to boost productivity and create better jobs, addressing worker concerns about job displacement. The government is using AI to ensure workers benefit from technological advancements, as stated by Prime Minister Lawrence Wong.

items.title: SK Hynix Said to Mull Options for $3 Billion Chongqing Plant
items.content: South Korea’s SK Hynix Inc. is considering options for its Chongqing, China-based facility, including bringing in an investor to help accelerate growth, according to people with knowledge of the matter.
items.contentSnippet: South Korea’s SK Hynix Inc. is considering options for its Chongqing, China-based facility, including bringing in an investor to help accelerate growth, according to people with knowledge of the matter.
items.creator: Pei Li and Dong Cao

summaries.zh: SK Hynix正考虑其位于中国重庆工厂的选项，包括引入投资者以加速增长。消息人士透露，韩国内存制造商正在评估多种方案。此举或旨在应对市场变化和扩大产能。
summaries.en: SK Hynix is evaluating options for its $3 billion Chongqing, China plant, including seeking an investor to boost growth, sources say. The company is exploring various strategies to enhance the facility's performance.

items.title: OpenAI Pauses Some Work on New Astra Model on Cyber Concerns
items.content: OpenAI is pausing some internal work around one of its upcoming artificial intelligence models to implement stricter safeguards after the system was found to be significantly more adept at cybersecurity tasks.
items.contentSnippet: OpenAI is pausing some internal work around one of its upcoming artificial intelligence models to implement stricter safeguards after the system was found to be significantly more adept at cybersecurity tasks.
items.creator: Seth Fiegerman

summaries.zh: OpenAI因新模型Astra在网络安全任务上表现突出，暂停部分内部研发工作，以加强安全防护措施。
summaries.en: OpenAI has temporarily halted development on its Astra model due to concerns about its advanced cybersecurity capabilities. The company plans to implement stricter safeguards before resuming work on the project.

items.summary: OpenAI因新模型Astra在网络安全任务上表现突出，暂停部分内部研发工作，以加强安全防护措施。

items.title: Data Center Firm Switch to File Confidentially for IPO
items.content: Switch Inc. filed confidentially for a US IPO, according to people familiar with the matter, joining its data center peers in tapping demand for exposure to the artificial intelligence theme.
items.contentSnippet: Switch Inc. filed confidentially for a US IPO, according to people familiar with the matter, joining its data center peers in tapping demand for exposure to the artificial intelligence theme.
items.creator: Bailey Lipschultz

summaries.zh: 据知情人士透露，数据中心公司Switch Inc.已秘密申请在美国进行首次公开募股(IPO)，该公司正加入其数据中心同行行列，利用人工智能主题带来的市场机遇。
summaries.en: Switch Inc. has confidentially filed for a U.S. IPO, sources confirm. The company is joining data center competitors seeking to capitalize on growing demand for AI-related exposure.

items.title: SoftBank-Backed 3D Printer Maker Formlabs Said to Weigh IPO
items.content: Formlabs, a maker of 3D printers, is in early talks with potential advisers for an initial public offering, according to people familiar with the matter.
items.contentSnippet: Formlabs, a maker of 3D printers, is in early talks with potential advisers for an initial public offering, according to people familiar with the matter.
items.creator: Bailey Lipschultz

summaries.zh: 据知情人士透露，软银投资支持的3D打印机制造商Formlabs正与潜在顾问进行早期接触，探讨首次公开募股事宜。
summaries.en: Formlabs, a 3D printer manufacturer backed by SoftBank, is reportedly in early discussions with potential advisors for an initial public offering (IPO). The company, known for its 3D printing technology, is exploring the possibility of going public. The talks indicate a potential step toward a formal IPO process, though no further details were provided.

items.title: Spelman President on Federal Funding, AI Popularity
items.content: Spelman College President, Dr. Ayanna Howard, sits down with Romaine Bostick to discuss the impact of federal funding rollbacks for HBCUs, and the impact of AI on college graduates. (Source: Bloomberg)
items.contentSnippet: Spelman College President, Dr. Ayanna Howard, sits down with Romaine Bostick to discuss the impact of federal funding rollbacks for HBCUs, and the impact of AI on college graduates. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 斯佩尔曼学院校长霍华德博士与罗曼尼·博斯蒂克对话，讨论了联邦资金削减对黑人大学的影响以及人工智能对大学毕业生的影响。（来源：彭博社）
summaries.en: Spelman College President Dr. Ayanna Howard discusses federal funding reductions for HBCUs and the effects of AI on college graduates in a Bloomberg interview with Romaine Bostick. The conversation addresses the challenges faced by historically Black colleges due to funding cuts and the evolving role of AI in shaping future careers. (50 words)

items.title: Akamai CEO on Earnings, Cloud Industry, New Investment
items.content: Akamai's shares declined following the release of its second-quarter earnings report, despite the company beating earnings estimates. Tom Leighton, Co-Founder and CEO of Akamai, joined the program to discuss the company's performance and recent developments. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
items.contentSnippet: Akamai's shares declined following the release of its second-quarter earnings report, despite the company beating earnings estimates. Tom Leighton, Co-Founder and CEO of Akamai, joined the program to discuss the company's performance and recent developments. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 阿卡迈（Akamai）第二季度财报发布后，股价下跌，尽管公司超出盈利预期。联合创始人兼CEO汤姆·莱特顿（Tom Leighton）接受“闭路电视”节目采访，讨论公司业绩及近期发展。来源：彭博社。
summaries.en: Akamai's shares fell after its second-quarter earnings beat estimates. CEO Tom Leighton discussed the company's performance and recent developments on "The Close" with Romaine Bostick. The report highlighted challenges in the cloud industry, though Akamai secured new investments. Leighton addressed market reactions and future strategies. (Word count: 50)

items.title: Gen CEO on Earnings, New Cybersecurity Attack Tracker
items.content: Gen Digital's shares are reaching their highest levels in nearly a year following an upward revision of its earnings forecast. Vincent Pilette, President and CEO of Gen Digital, expressed strong confidence in sustaining double-digit growth over the coming quarters, driven by increased demand for cybersecurity solutions amid growing concerns related to AI and agentic technologies. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
items.contentSnippet: Gen Digital's shares are reaching their highest levels in nearly a year following an upward revision of its earnings forecast. Vincent Pilette, President and CEO of Gen Digital, expressed strong confidence in sustaining double-digit growth over the coming quarters, driven by increased demand for cybersecurity solutions amid growing concerns related to AI and agentic technologies. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: Gen Digital股价近一年新高，因业绩预期上调。公司CEO Vincent Pilette表示，受AI和代理技术安全担忧加剧推动，网络安全解决方案需求增长，未来季度有望维持两位数增长。他还接受了"The Close"的采访。(信息来源：彭博)
summaries.en: Gen Digital's shares hit a nearly year-high after its earnings forecast was raised. CEO Vincent Pilette, speaking with Bloomberg's Romaine Bostick, expressed confidence in double-digit growth, citing rising demand for cybersecurity solutions due to growing AI and agentic technology concerns. The company is leveraging these trends to bolster its market position.
